meta.title: K-Arena Yokohama (Kアリーナ横浜) parametric model specification
meta.units: metres, degrees; elevations are above the arena floor (LEVEL 1 = 1FL = model z 0) unless a field name says otherwise
meta.confidenceTags: CONFIRMED = official / primary source or official survey data; REPORTED = credible secondary source, or a designer drawing whose digits are only partly legible; ESTIMATED = derived by the editors (derivation given)
meta.confNotes: Every object carries a sibling _conf object that maps each numeric field name to "TAG: source or derivation".

frames.arenaFrame_G: origin S0 = symmetry axis x stage-end outer facade; +Y_G along bearing 303.25 deg (stage to rear); +X_G along bearing 33.25 deg (north-east = house-left when facing the stage); Z up
frames.hallFrame_H: X_H = X_G; Y_H = Y_G - 34.7 (origin = centre of the stage front line at arena floor level); Z up from the arena floor
frames.seatmapFrame_S: frame of research/seatmap.md (X_S positive toward audience right, Y_S from the seat datum). Conversion: X_H = -0.97 * X_S ; Y_H = 0.97 * Y_S + 1.2 ; heights: use tiers[].rowElevation of this file
frames.threeJs: for a three.js scene with X east, Y up, Z south and origin S0: east = 0.54829*X_G - 0.83629*Y_G ; north = 0.83629*X_G + 0.54829*Y_G ; x = east ; y = z ; z = -north
frames.angles: block start / end angles are azimuths at the hall-frame origin measured from the +Y_H axis, positive toward house-right (the direction of increasing seat numbers)
frames.radii: tier radii are apothems: perpendicular distance from the fan apex A (on the axis, 32.6 m upstage of the stage front, Y_G 2.1) to a row line. A row of one tier has the same apothem on the centre facet and on both wing facets (facet normals at 0 and +-33.6 deg)

meta.seatData: Row-by-row seat table (19,893 seats): research/seatmap.md, Appendix A JSON. Apply the seatmapFrame_S conversion above.
